method: Three sequential CPU-0 alternating inline4/inline1 runs, middle reversed, 20000 compile/drop or resolve iterations per case; summaries are medians of three run means. Parent exports and variable files restored exactly from HEAD; other reachable source and common benchmark source match parent. Working sources restored in finally. These paths have no intended algorithm change.
followup_method: Initial common named-color parse medians showed +12.4% with bimodal individual samples. Three additional alternating parent/default color runs were captured to investigate; preserve both datasets. Follow-up medians reverse the direction. No uniform regression/speedup guarantee or algorithm attribution from this uncontrolled variation.
caveats: Original Syntax/source lexical and generic statement costs are excluded from the property microbench; common CSS benchmark retains its original workload.
No concurrent checks launched by this session during samples; other machine load, clocks, thermals, allocator/hash/code layout remain uncontrolled.
Arena/heap accounting excludes allocator metadata, original Syntax and runtime host state. RSS includes runtime/library/allocator retention and transient buffers; not page/browser memory.
Value dependencies cover numeric/color/substitution tokens; actual font, logical-axis, cascade, layout and lifecycle dependencies belong to the future style host.
Limits preflight nodes/source spans and bound each nested scanner/compiler, not an exact combined whole-stylesheet work or memory counter. Shorthands have at most four members.
No new SIMD/GPU implementation or background/idle work here. Native copies and existing tokenizer/math/color machinery remain in use.
